_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment; ADR-031 declarative fields, the yearly sum stays imperative in Ib47BatchService
_meta.description: A payee can be marked as an IB47 recipient and carries what the statement asks of it (BSN and the payment type code); an IB47 record names the payee it was prepared from, so preparing a year again updates that record instead of adding a second.

ib47Recipient.title: IB47 recipient
ib47Recipient.description: True for someone paid outside the payroll who must be reported to the Belastingdienst once a year on the IB47 statement, such as a freelancer without a VAT number or a volunteer above the allowance.

bsn.title: BSN
bsn.description: Burgerservicenummer of an IB47 recipient, which the statement names. Special-category PII (ADR-005): validated by the 11-proef on write (OpenRegister's bsn format), masked as ***<last4> on display, readable and writable only to the payroll officer, never written to the audit trail.

ib47PaymentTypeCode.title: IB47 payment type
ib47PaymentTypeCode.description: The Belastingdienst IB47 payment type code for this recipient's payments. A recipient without one is left out of the batch and named as incomplete, rather than reported under a code nobody chose.

payeeId.title: Payee
payeeId.description: The payee this record was prepared from. Preparing the same year again updates the record of this payee and never writes a second one.
